checks.detail: CONTROL: with the firewall open the intruder received 1 live frame(s) on B's inbox topic and 1 on A's topic via relay (first within 4105 ms of the rule change, after 1 sends), and its Store query against R returned 20 stored frame(s) for B's topic. Cluster/shard separation is NOT access control.

the 22 frame(s) the intruder obtained contain no plaintext marker or address (payload sizes [564,564,564,564,564,564,564,564,564,564,564,564,564,564,564,564,564,564,564,564,564,564]): ciphertext only. That is the application-layer E2E encryption working, and exactly why cluster/shard separation is not access control: the intruder still learns topics, timing, sizes and sees the traffic of everyone on the shard.
